name: agent-lens
description: Work with the agent in one place: each edit checked against your CLAUDE.md as it is made and each turn's diff reviewed (/changes); the OpenSpec change read for you (/spec); the skill each prompt needs loaded for it (/router).

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of every part and of what its model answers: en or ru; /changes lang, /spec lang and /router lang override it

live.title: Rules while Claude edits
live.description: warn: check each edit against CLAUDE.md as it lands and tell Claude what it broke; block: check it before it lands and refuse it; off: leave the rules to the review after the turn

liveModel.title: Model for the edit check
liveModel.description: The model that checks each edit against the rules: an alias like haiku or a full model id

includeUserRules.title: Include ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
includeUserRules.description: Also check edits and reviews against your personal CLAUDE.md

specCritic.title: Critic for the spec
specCritic.description: An agent that reads the OpenSpec change against the code for holes. off; button: when you press f on Decide; auto: also after each turn that changes the change, sending what it finds to Claude to close, three rounds in a row at most. /spec critic overrides it

routerUseModel.title: Route with a model
routerUseModel.description: Where none of your rules fits, ask a small model which skill fits the prompt (about a second per prompt)

routerModel.title: Model for routing
routerModel.description: The model that picks the skill: an alias like haiku or a full model id
